title: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2022 — G.S.R. 279(E)

content.publisher: Gazette of India / Ministry of Corporate Affairs
content.citation: G.S.R. 279(E), 6 April 2022, Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2022
content.note: Official Gazette PDF inspected. The operative amendment inserts rule 14(3) concerning specified personal particulars in member registers/indices/returns and does not amend rule 17 or rule 18. The notification's amendment-history note lists the preceding instruments through G.S.R. 159(E), 5 March 2021. This is limited negative-scope evidence for this instrument only; it does not prove that no other amendment affects Rules 17 or 18, and does not establish a consolidated current text.
